summary.text: Dakota Adams is the Democratic candidate for Montana House of Representatives District 1 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the June 2 Democratic primary.
According to his campaign website, he is a drywall worker and part-time student in Lincoln County.

paragraphs.text: Dakota Adams says on his campaign website that he has lived in Montana since 2011 and in Lincoln County since 2014, when his family moved to Trego.
He states that he joined his rural volunteer fire department, worked in wildland fire and then construction, and now works full time as a drywall worker while studying part time.
Adams was the Democratic candidate for the same seat in 2024 and lost in the general election, according to Ballotpedia.
